aiSummary.overview: Analysis of the current cloud resource landscape reveals significant potential for cost reduction through resource rightsizing, termination of idle infrastructure, and the implementation of automated scheduling for non-production environments.
keyFindings: Significant waste detected due to idle compute and database instances.
Multiple oversized instances in production and testing environments exceeding resource requirements.
Unused S3 storage buckets accumulating costs without operational activity.
nextSteps: Terminate resources identified as idle to immediately capture monthly cost savings.
Right-size oversized EC2 instances to align with observed CPU and memory utilization patterns.
Configure automated lifecycle policies or scheduling for non-production resources to optimize usage patterns.

recommendations.title: Terminate idle RDS instance rds-cp1250-general-ci-3y5khmbq
recommendations.description: Resource shows extremely low CPU utilization (2.40%). Given its status as a testing instance, termination will eliminate unnecessary spend.
recommendations.actionableSteps: - Verify no downstream dependencies exist in the testing pipeline. - Execute RDS termination via AWS CLI: aws rds delete-db-instance --db-instance-identifier rds-cp1250-general-ci-3y5khmbq --skip-final-snapshot

recommendations.title: Terminate idle RDS instance rds-cp1250-bin-mzlffkww
recommendations.description: RDS instance is consistently idle with CPU utilization at 2.52%.
recommendations.actionableSteps: - Assess the necessity of the testing database environment. - Terminate the instance using the RDS console or CLI.

recommendations.title: Downsize oversized EC2 instance i-C701577D7D6DdCfAA
recommendations.description: The current t3.2xlarge instance is significantly over-provisioned with max CPU at 12% and memory at 17%. Downgrading to a smaller instance class will reduce costs while maintaining performance.
recommendations.actionableSteps: - Stop the instance. - Modify the instance type to a smaller tier (e.g., t3.large). - Start the instance.

recommendations.title: Right-size oversized EC2 instance i-ff2B9EC27CDcC4b7f
recommendations.description: Production testing instance is underutilized with max 12% CPU. Migration to a smaller instance type is recommended.
recommendations.actionableSteps: - Perform instance type modification to t3.medium via AWS EC2 console.

recommendations.title: Implement automated scheduling for instance i-b2BfAaF9e7eCeAF2c
recommendations.description: Development instance exhibits high idle time. Implementing a stop/start schedule for non-working hours will yield substantial savings.
recommendations.actionableSteps: - Use AWS Instance Scheduler to stop the instance between 8 PM and 7 AM daily.

recommendations.title: Clean up unattached S3 bucket uniform-cappelletti-9786
recommendations.description: Bucket exhibits zero operations over 7 days, indicating it is unused and contributing to storage overhead.
recommendations.actionableSteps: - Backup any essential objects to an archive. - Delete the bucket contents. - Delete the bucket through the S3 Management Console.
